$comment: Hand-transcribed ground truth for the Dreimann example trades (research/dreimann/*.png + trades.txt). These labels are the acceptance bar for Phase 0 annotation-fidelity tests — LOGIC CORRECTNESS ONLY. No numeric threshold may ever be tuned against them (risk R5 in research/analysis.md). Times marked approx* are read off the charts and pinned to the first fixture bar consistent with them; prices come from trades.txt or the chart position tool as noted in each source field.
